title: 第27章惊喜第28章感慨
slug: 我的民俗游戏机第227章权限
content_zh:
都是一根一根的线香。
这些线香的香烟，似乎都随着师父的行走而流动，甚至于，许峰惊鸿一瞥之间看到，这些香烟化作了一缕桥。
顺着那竹竿顶开的“出煞口”走。
许峰继续回想，这一次，师父和他说的每一句话，许峰尽量都记得。
记不得的。
许峰就此略过。
许峰可以确定，在游戏之中，昨天晚上那场缝尸里头。
师父一定在言语之中，不知不觉透露出来了有用信息。
并且自己一定记住了。
不然不会像是现在这样，有这么严重的“心理暗示”。
所以是哪一句？
“修德在于心。”
“香可通神。”
还是，“缝尸缝凶！”
许峰的脑中，不断闪回着，到了最后，闪回到自己和师父一起上前，硬生生的将这黄河里头溺死的尸体，就此扳倒在桌子上。
叫师父缝住了此人。
这个场面，哪里有问题？
哪里都有问题。
师父有问题，尸体有问题。
就许峰暂时没问题。

“那一张脸，那奇怪的竹林，就是师父不要土地神庇佑的原因么？他另有手段，所以那是甚么？
阴神？鬼？曾经招惹之物，还是所谓的缝凶之法带来的恶果？”
许峰不解，但是他从结果反推过程。
旁人或许以为这“缝尸缝凶”是个甚么一体的搭配词语，但是许峰清楚，不是，缝凶是另外一种技能！并且是赵三想要学会的技能。
从此点上来看，师父这一次不求土地神增益，原因可能就在这里！
他要将这身后的“东西”用出来。
所以不能用土地神的增益。
也是因为许峰陷入了这般的闪回冥想之中。
他强行将自己最后的交感“无视”。
更多的回想到当时的情景。
那黄河之中打捞出来的尸体，脖子上有一个极大的口子。
这口子之中浸满了泥沙，已经泛白。
这就是缝尸人须得缝住的伤口。
同样，这也是第一次，也是唯一一次，许峰在这“男尸”之上，见到了另外一张脸。
哪怕是现在，许峰已经脱离了游戏，可是回想起来了那一张脸，许峰还是怵然。
content_en:
They are all incense sticks.
These incense cigarettes seemed to flow as the master walked, and Xu Feng even saw with a startled glance that these cigarettes turned into a wisp of bridge.
Follow the "escape" of the bamboo pole.
Xu Feng continued to think about it. This time, Xu Feng tried his best to remember every word his master said to him.
Can't remember.
Xu Feng ignored it.
Xu Feng can be sure that in the game, the scene of sewing corpses last night was inside.
Master must have revealed useful information unknowingly in his words.
And I must have remembered it.
Otherwise, there wouldn't be such serious "psychological implications" as it is now.
So which sentence is it?
"Cultivation of virtue lies in the heart."
"Fragrance can help the spirit."
Still, "It's fierce to sew on corpses!"
Xu Feng kept flashing back in his mind. In the end, he flashed back to himself and his master stepping forward together and forcibly knocking the drowned body in the Yellow River down on the table.
Ask the master to sew this person up.
What's wrong with this scene?
There are problems everywhere.
There's something wrong with the master, there's something wrong with the body.
Xu Feng is fine for now.
"Is that face and the strange bamboo forest the reason why Master doesn't want the blessing of the land god? He has other means, so what is that?
Yin Shen? Ghost? Something that has been provoked in the past, or is it the consequences of the so-called method of sewing evil? "
Xu Feng was puzzled, but he deduced the process from the results.
Others may think that "sewing corpses and sewing murders" is a collocation of words, but Xu Feng knows that no, sewing murders is another skill! And it is a skill that Zhao San wants to learn.
From this point of view, this may be the reason why Master does not ask the Earth God for gain this time!
He wanted to use the "thing" behind him.
Therefore, you cannot use the buff of the land god.
It was also because Xu Feng fell into such flashback meditation.
He forced himself to "ignore" his last sympathy.
Think more back to the scene at that time.
The corpse fished out of the Yellow River had a huge hole in its neck.
The hole was filled with sand and turned white.
This is the wound that the seamer must sew up.
Likewise, this was also the first and only time that Xu Feng saw another face on top of this "male corpse".
Even now, Xu Feng has left the game, but when he recalls that face, Xu Feng is still frightened.
